artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-v.description: A composite evaluation of language model performance across knowledge work, coding, science, and general knowledge, aggregating nine evaluations into a single score.
artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-v.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

automationbench-v1.0.6.description: Evaluates agents' ability to complete cross-application workflows in simulated business applications, using the percentage of tasks for which all assertions pass as the primary metric. The official leaderboard uses a separate, held-out private task set; results on the public task set should not be treated as equivalent.
automationbench-v1.0.6.name: AutomationBench

chartography.description: Evaluates visual reading, domain interpretation, and multi-step chart reasoning using charts from specialized fields and expert-written questions. Official materials describe 100 tasks but do not specify a semantic version; tool-use conditions and multiple-sampling metrics must be recorded separately.
chartography.name: Chartography

deepswe-v1.1.description: Evaluates coding agents on 113 long-horizon software engineering tasks; v1.1 validates agent-submitted patches in isolated environments.
deepswe-v1.1.name: DeepSWE

gdpval-aa-v2.1.description: An independent Artificial Analysis evaluation of OpenAI's public GDPval dataset, using 220 tasks across 44 occupations. Models produce professional work outputs in an agentic setting; blinded pairwise comparisons judged by LLMs sampled from a judge panel are aggregated into an Elo rating.
gdpval-aa-v2.1.name: GDPval-AA

humanitys-last-exam.description: A multimodal academic question-answering benchmark covering more than 100 disciplines. This definition refers to the original 2,500-question set officially finalized on 2025-04-03; the official materials do not assign it a semantic version, and it excludes HLE-Rolling and HLE-Diamond.
humanitys-last-exam.name: Humanity's Last Exam
humanitys-last-exam.organization: Center for AI Safety / Scale AI

osworld-v2.1.description: Evaluates agents' ability to complete long-horizon computer-use workflows in real desktop environments and applications. This definition uses binary task completion rate; partial credit is a different scoring measure and must not be conflated with completion rate.
osworld-v2.1.name: OSWorld

swe-bench-pro-v2.description: Evaluates agents' ability to solve long-horizon software engineering tasks in real-world codebases using hidden tests. The V2 default configuration contains 642 tasks; the HARD subset and the original 731-task V1 configuration are different datasets and should not be combined with the default configuration.
swe-bench-pro-v2.name: SWE-bench Pro

terminal-bench-science-v0.1.description: Evaluates agents on 70 expert-curated, terminal-based research workflows across the life, physical, Earth, mathematical, and engineering sciences. Task-specific tests verify outputs such as scientific data analyses, simulations, optimizations, proofs, and model fits.
terminal-bench-science-v0.1.name: Terminal-Bench-Science

terminal-bench-v4.description: Evaluates agents' ability to perform tasks such as software development, scientific computing, security, and system administration in a sandboxed terminal; this version changes the task set, environments, and resource configurations.
terminal-bench-v4.name: Terminal-Bench

vals-index-v2.2.description: Aggregates agent performance on finance, coding, legal, and tax tasks using weights proportional to each sector's share of U.S. GDP, with the information sector used as a proxy for coding.
vals-index-v2.2.name: Vals Index
